rows.behaviorContract: Every tool, source, provenance, cache, overlay, configuration, and public JSON schema identifier remains fixed to the single ADRAI 1 contract.
rows.haskellTestName: all internal source cache and public contracts remain version one

rows.behaviorContract: The default configuration contains exactly the v1 managed roots and trunk line while excluding vector, cache, and database configuration.

evidence.command: stack test adrai:adrai-test --test-arguments=--pattern="default configuration has exact committed bytes and typed v1 values"

rows.behaviorContract: The v1 configuration parser rejects every unsupported top-level table instead of silently accepting extension points.

evidence.command: stack test adrai:adrai-test --test-arguments=--pattern="configuration parser rejects unsupported top level tables"

evidence.command: stack test adrai:adrai-test --test-arguments=--pattern="configuration schema and managed roots are strict"

rows.behaviorContract: Distribution metadata declares the ADRAI 1 executable and release maturity without requiring a Python dependency set at runtime.

rows.translationNote: Python-only pyproject keys, classifiers, requires-python, and empty runtime dependencies do not exist in the native distribution; P7 verifies the corresponding package version and adrai executable metadata instead.

rows.translationNote: The Python -m adrai_core entrypoint is replaced by the installed native adrai executable; its --help and --version behavior is the Haskell parity surface.
